decided.singular: I picked out narrow spikes that rise above about 6.5 on a baseline that mostly sits around 1-4, with the tallest near day 316 (about 8.7) and day 1 (about 8).
decided.recurrence: Peaks look somewhat regularly spaced in the second half of the year, roughly 246, 258, 273, 291 and 316, but the gaps vary too much in this dense line plot to commit to a single period.
decided.quarter: Q2 (elevated 92-115, spike at about 152) and Q4 (spikes at about 273 and 316, elevated 330-360) look about equally active, and Q3 is clearly the quietest, so no single quarter clearly wins.

answer.guess: A geomagnetic activity index such as the 3-hourly Kp index (0-9 scale, eight values per day).
